source_review.notes: Checked the Enterprise Integration Patterns Canonical Data Model pattern, Fowler's Bounded Context article, OASIS UBL 2.4, HL7 FHIR R5, current NIEM model-content guidance, ISO/IEC 11179-3:2023, W3C RDF 1.1 Concepts, and RFC 9413. Six destinations returned HTTP 200. The official ISO record was retrievable through source review but rejected the command-line client with HTTP 403; the NIEM destination was source-reviewed through the indexed current page but the command-line DNS lookup failed during final retrieval. Claims remain bounded to each source's pattern, specification, guidance, or protocol scope.
